answer: The best way to remember names is to repeat the name over and over as soon as you hear it and then just say it again a few times that night before sleep. This makes the brain important the information so it stays. Another big tip is to recruit someone else to quiz you: doing recall tests within twenty-four hours shows you have learned the name. Specific detail also helps; tying a name to a meaningless acronym or an obscure fact is extra unnecessary because most people remember simple ones naturally.
